name: read
description: Read a file. Emits `file_sha256=<64hex> lines=<N>` then lines as `<n>:<h>|<text>` where h is the first 6 hex chars of SHA-256 over the line bytes with trailing newline stripped. Use start/end (1-based) for ranges.

name: edit
description: Anchor-based edit. Each edit has start/end anchors of the form `<n>:<h>` produced by `read`, plus new_text. The whole call is rejected (STALE + fresh anchors) if any anchor or file_sha256 mismatches. Applies bottom-up, preserves line endings, writes atomically.

name: write
description: Write a file. New files allowed. Overwriting requires the file was read this session and file_sha256 still matches, else STALE.

name: bash
description: Run a shell command inside the sandbox (zsandbox exec --workspace <ws> --net deny). Output capped at 30000 chars. Optional wait=now|next_write|exit (default exit); from_offset reads only new log bytes.

name: grep
description: Search file contents. Respects .gitignore. Output `path:line:text`, capped at 200 matches.

name: glob
description: List files matching a glob pattern, relative to the workspace.

name: memory_search
description: Search the shared Meridian memory vault (BM25 over memory and playbook headings). Optional scope: memory|sessions|playbook (default memory).

name: memory_write
description: Write a durable memory to the shared Meridian vault.

name: task
description: Run a subagent: a fresh conversation over the same stable prefix. Returns only final text (<=4000 chars).

name: request_escalation
description: Request a capability grant: network | write_outside_workspace | unsandboxed. Never silent; operator decision is logged.

name: submit_plan
description: Submit the implementation plan. Only available in plan mode.

name: tool_search
description: Search configured MCP servers' tool schemas; returns them as text.

name: mcp_call
description: Invoke a tool on a configured MCP server.

name: context_remaining
description: Report current context budget: tokens_in, tokens_budget, percent, cache_warm.

name: new_context
description: Force L5 compact and reseed the conversation from world.md.
